b: This Dewalt ToughSystem 2.0 3-drawer tool box has been discounted to $99 at Acme Tools and $109 at Home Depot.
Last year it was $119 for Black Friday.
$99 is a fantastic price. Even $109 is very good.

Frankly, I think this a great tool box. I bought a bunch but have since donated them. They work okay together, and I really liked using it and other Dewalt drawered tool boxes separately rather than as part of a system.
A tower of these drawered tool boxes are a bit wobbly. It was tolerable, just a little annoying. But place it on a workbench, steel tool cabinet, or shelving rack and it’s great there.
The drawered tool boxes also work well with the larger ToughSystem DXL components.
I mention all this because the ToughSystem modular compatibility is great, but I think it should be considered by itself as well.
I’ll leave it up to you. The deal should be valid for a while.
If ordering from Acme Tools, coupon code TOOLGUYD takes $10 off $79, and resets once every 30 days. It tends to override other promos, so use it carefully.
